title: Hunyuan-T1
paper_type_zh: 前沿推理模型官方发布
best_for_zh: 研究 RL、奖励披露与推理模型系统报告的读者
one_line: Hunyuan-T1 reports that 96.7% of post-training compute went to RL over broad science-and-reasoning problems, with curriculum, replay/reset, ground-truth feedback, and T1-preview-plus-reward-model preference scoring, but releases none of the underlying training records or reward implementation.
Hunyuan-T1 披露了重 RL 的后训练、课程和混合奖励，但未公开数据与奖励账本。
why: It is a compact disclosure-ledger case: several system-level post-training components are named, yet the data object, verifier semantics, reward aggregation, stage accounting, rights, and reproducibility artifacts remain unknown.
inclusion_reason: A frontier reasoning-model release with unusually explicit RL compute allocation and named curriculum, replay/reset, and mixed preference-feedback components, while leaving the actual data records and reward contract unreleased.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Hunyuan-T1 was released by Tencent on March 21, 2025 as a deep-reasoning model built by large-scale post-training of the TurboS fast-thinking base, a Hybrid-Transformer-Mamba MoE model. For this atlas, the relevant question is not whether the model obtains high benchmark scores. It is what post-training data and feedback can actually be audited from the release.

Tencent states that 96.7% of post-training compute was allocated to reinforcement learning for reasoning and human-preference alignment. The disclosed training surface consists only of broad “world science and reasoning problems” in mathematics, logical reasoning, science, and code. No dataset names, item counts, source manifest, record schema, model outputs, or reward logs are released. The authoritative source for Hunyuan-T1 itself is therefore an official release page and content repository, not a formal T1 technical paper or data/model release.

腾讯于 2025 年 3 月 21 日发布 Hunyuan-T1，称其以 Hybrid-Transformer-Mamba MoE 架构的 TurboS 快思考基座为起点，通过大规模后训练形成深度推理模型。对本图谱而言，关键问题不是模型在基准上得分多高，而是发布材料究竟让哪些后训练数据与反馈机制可被审计。

腾讯称后训练算力的 96.7% 用于强化学习，目标包括推理能力和人类偏好对齐。已披露的训练表面仅是数学、逻辑推理、科学与代码四类宽泛的“世界理科难题”。官方没有发布数据集名称、样本数、来源清单、记录格式、模型输出或奖励日志。因此，Hunyuan-T1 本身的一手依据是官方发布页与内容仓库，而不是正式的 T1 技术论文或数据/模型发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The release outlines two feedback stages. Reasoning RL uses problems in four broad domains with what Tencent calls ground-truth real feedback. The release does not define that phrase operationally: it could involve exact answers, symbolic checks, tests, or another mechanism, so the verifier type and terminal predicate remain unknown. A curriculum reportedly raises problem difficulty while context length is expanded in stages.

For longer-run optimization, Tencent reports data replay and periodic policy resetting. Preference alignment then uses a unified reward system combining self-rewarding—an early T1-preview version evaluates and scores model outputs—with an unnamed reward model. This supports a mixed-feedback classification at answer/scalar-reward level, but not a claim of an open or fully programmatic RLVR pipeline.

The key data object is consequently only partially specified: problem prompts and generated outputs must participate in training, but their schema, reasoning-trace retention, references, reward fields, accepted/rejected states, and linkage across stages are undisclosed. The Card records the released mechanism names without filling those missing records by inference.

发布材料勾勒出两个反馈阶段。推理 RL 使用四类宽泛问题，并采用腾讯所称的 ground-truth 真实反馈；但官方没有给出可操作定义。它可能对应精确答案、符号检查、测试或其他机制，因此验证器类型和终止判据仍是 unknown。课程学习据称逐步提高题目难度，同时分阶段扩展上下文长度。

为维持长期优化，腾讯报告使用数据回放和阶段性策略重置。随后的人类偏好对齐采用统一奖励系统：self-rewarding 由早期 T1-preview 版本对模型输出进行评价与打分，再与未具名 reward model 结合。这足以把反馈归为 answer/scalar-reward 级的混合类型，却不足以声称存在开放或完全程序化的 RLVR 流水线。

因此，核心数据对象只得到部分界定：训练必然涉及问题提示和模型输出，但其记录格式、推理轨迹是否保留、参考答案、奖励字段、接受/拒绝状态以及跨阶段连接都未披露。本 Card 只记录官方点名的机制，不用推断补齐缺失记录。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reported reasoning-RL input pool covers mathematics, logical reasoning, science, and code, ranging from basic mathematical reasoning to complex scientific problem solving. The official materials do not name a source corpus, distinguish public, licensed, internal, or synthetic items, or provide counts and mixture weights. They also do not identify a rollout generator, output format, correctness filter, split, or replay-buffer record.

The curriculum has two stated axes: increasing data difficulty and stepwise context-length expansion. Data replay and periodic policy resetting are said to improve long-term training stability by more than 50%, but the release omits the metric, baseline, reset cadence, replay policy, and curves. It also omits the RL algorithm, objective, rollout count, temperature, batch size, optimizer, learning rate, KL or clipping settings, total tokens, and hardware.

The feedback layer must be kept stage-specific. Ground-truth feedback is named for reasoning RL, but its checker is unspecified. During preference alignment, an early T1-preview evaluator scores outputs and an unnamed reward model supplies the other component of a unified reward system. Their prompts, checkpoints, aggregation weights, thresholds, calibration, error analysis, and score logs are unknown. No training code, verifier code, dataset, checkpoint, or substantive model card was found in the checked official artifacts.

报告中的推理 RL 输入池覆盖数学、逻辑推理、科学与代码，从基础数学推理延伸到复杂科学问题求解。官方材料没有给出来源语料名称，也没有区分公开、许可、内部或合成样本，更未披露数量与混合权重。rollout 生成器、输出格式、正确性过滤、数据划分和回放缓冲区记录同样未知。

课程学习有两个已披露轴：逐步提高数据难度，以及阶梯式扩展上下文长度。数据回放与阶段性策略重置据称使长期训练稳定性提升 50% 以上，但发布材料没有定义指标、基线、重置周期、回放策略或训练曲线。RL 算法、目标函数、rollout 数、temperature、batch size、优化器、学习率、KL/裁剪设置、总 token 和硬件也均未披露。

反馈层必须按阶段区分。推理 RL 点名使用 ground-truth feedback，却没有说明检查器；偏好对齐则由早期 T1-preview 评价器为输出打分，再与未具名 reward model 构成统一奖励系统。两者的提示、检查点、聚合权重、阈值、校准、误差分析和分数日志都是 unknown。已核查官方产物中没有训练代码、验证器代码、数据集、模型检查点或实质性模型卡。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official Hunyuan-T1 release page and Tencent GitHub repository support the TurboS-base statement, the 96.7% RL-compute allocation, four reasoning domains, ground-truth feedback, difficulty/context curriculum, replay/reset, and T1-preview-plus-reward-model preference feedback. The official Tencent Cloud launch record dates the release to March 21, 2025, while the product history records later API versions; neither is a training-data release.

The official Hunyuan-T1 Hugging Face Space is an API-backed demo with a thin application README, not a model-weight repository or a substantive training model card. The later official Hunyuan-TurboS technical report documents the TurboS family and refers to Hunyuan-T1 in TurboS's adaptive-CoT construction, but it does not retroactively disclose Hunyuan-T1's own RL dataset, reward implementation, or exact base checkpoint.

The release reports benchmark scores and a more-than-50% stability improvement. These are author-reported model/system outcomes. Without released records, metrics, baselines, verifier specifications, contamination analysis, or reward audits, they are not evidence that the hidden training data are accurate, representative, legally reusable, or high quality.

官方 Hunyuan-T1 发布页与腾讯 GitHub 仓库支持以下事实：模型基于 TurboS、后训练算力的 96.7% 用于 RL、覆盖四类推理领域、使用 ground-truth feedback，并采用难度/上下文课程、回放/重置以及 T1-preview 加 reward model 的偏好反馈。官方腾讯云首发记录把发布日期定为 2025 年 3 月 21 日，产品动态则记录后续 API 版本；两者都不是训练数据发布。

官方 Hunyuan-T1 Hugging Face Space只是 API 驱动的演示，README 也仅描述轻量应用，并非模型权重仓库或实质性训练模型卡。后续官方 Hunyuan-TurboS 技术报告记录了 TurboS 家族，并在 TurboS 的 adaptive-CoT 构造中提到 Hunyuan-T1，但它没有追溯披露 Hunyuan-T1 自身的 RL 数据集、奖励实现或确切基座检查点。

发布材料给出基准分数，并声称训练稳定性提升 50% 以上。这些都是作者报告的模型/系统结果。缺少公开记录、指标定义、基线、验证器规格、污染分析和奖励审计时，它们不能证明隐藏训练数据准确、有代表性、可合法复用或质量较高。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Relative to a release that says only “trained with RL,” Hunyuan-T1 discloses several useful system-level anchors: an exact post-training compute share, a two-axis curriculum, replay and policy reset, a ground-truth reasoning signal, and a separate self-reward-plus-reward-model preference stage. Together they show that the pipeline is not one homogeneous RL dataset or reward.

The direction signal for the frontier-reports data-disclosure ledger is the separation of what is named from what is inspectable. The release names mechanisms more concretely than it defines data records. A later Hunyuan-TurboS report provides much richer post-training detail for a related model family, but that information cannot be copied into Hunyuan-T1 unless the report explicitly binds the stage or checkpoint. The Card's novelty is therefore an auditable disclosure boundary, not a claimed new algorithm or benchmark lead.

相较只写“使用 RL 训练”的发布，Hunyuan-T1 给出了一组有用的系统级锚点：确切的后训练算力占比、双轴课程、数据回放与策略重置、ground-truth 推理信号，以及独立的 self-reward 加 reward-model 偏好阶段。这些信息共同说明，整条流水线不能被简化为一个同质的 RL 数据集或单一奖励。

对于“前沿报告与数据披露账本”，方向信号在于区分“被点名的机制”和“可检查的记录”。该发布对机制的命名比对数据记录的定义更具体。后续 Hunyuan-TurboS 报告为相关模型家族提供了更丰富的后训练细节，但除非报告明确绑定阶段或检查点，否则不能把这些信息直接移植到 Hunyuan-T1。因而，本 Card 的新意是建立可审计的披露边界，而不是宣称新算法或基准领先。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Data disclosure stops at domain labels. There is no item inventory, source count, source license ledger, synthetic-data share, collection date, prompt/reference schema, reasoning-trace policy, stage yield, split manifest, or accepted/rejected record. Decontamination and benchmark-overlap procedures are unknown, so the reported scores cannot rule out leakage.

The feedback contract is not reproducible. “Ground-truth real feedback” does not identify a verifier or terminal rule. The early T1-preview evaluator and reward model are not versioned or released, and their prompts, rubrics, weights, aggregation, thresholds, calibration, and failure behavior are absent. Replay and policy reset likewise lack buffer semantics, cadence, and ablations; the claimed stability gain has no published metric definition or baseline.

The official GitHub repository contains release-page material rather than training implementation, and the official Hugging Face artifact is a demo Space rather than downloadable weights or a substantive model card. Exact T1 parameter count, base snapshot, maximum context, training compute, model license, safety data, and deployment-time inference budget remain unknown. The later TurboS report should be treated as related context, not as proof of these T1-specific facts.

数据披露停留在领域标签层面。官方没有给出样本清单、各来源数量、来源许可账本、合成数据占比、采集日期、提示/参考答案格式、推理轨迹保留策略、阶段产率、划分清单或接受/拒绝记录。去污染与基准重叠程序也是 unknown，因此已报告分数不能排除泄漏。

反馈合同不可复现。“ground-truth 真实反馈”没有识别验证器或终止规则。早期 T1-preview 评价器和 reward model 均未版本化或发布，其提示、rubric、权重、聚合、阈值、校准与失败行为缺失。数据回放和策略重置也没有缓冲区语义、周期或消融；所谓稳定性提升没有公开指标定义与基线。

官方 GitHub 仓库承载的是发布页材料而非训练实现，官方 Hugging Face 产物则是演示 Space，而非可下载权重或实质性模型卡。T1 的确切参数量、基座快照、最大上下文、训练算力、模型许可、安全数据和部署时推理预算仍是 unknown。后续 TurboS 报告只能作为相关背景，不能证明这些 T1 特定事实。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the frontier reports and data-disclosure ledger track, Hunyuan-T1 is a compact case for auditing closed industrial reasoning pipelines. It lets curators distinguish compute allocation from data volume, broad domain names from source manifests, “ground truth” from a specified verifier, and an official demo from a released model or dataset.

For post-training comparisons, record two stages rather than collapsing them: reasoning RL with an unspecified ground-truth signal, and preference alignment with an early T1-preview evaluator plus a reward model. Record curriculum, replay, and policy reset as disclosed scaffolds, but keep their implementations and configurations unknown. The release supports rlvr and preference_learning use labels at a high level; it does not support open-data, open-weight, process-supervision, or fully reproducible-RL claims.

A reuse effort would need independently sourced and licensed problems, explicit reference and verifier semantics, versioned rollout/evaluator checkpoints, replay and reset specifications, immutable stage manifests, reward calibration, and contamination checks. Until those artifacts appear, this Card is suitable for cross-report disclosure comparison and audit-question design, not for reconstructing the Hunyuan-T1 recipe.

在“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道中，Hunyuan-T1 是审计封闭工业推理流水线的紧凑案例。它促使策展者区分：算力占比与数据量、宽泛领域名与来源清单、“ground truth”与已定义验证器，以及官方演示与真正发布的模型或数据集。

比较后训练方案时，应记录两个阶段而非把它们合并：一是使用未明确 ground-truth 信号的推理 RL，二是由早期 T1-preview 评价器加 reward model 组成的偏好对齐。课程、回放与策略重置可记为已披露 scaffold，但其实现与配置保持 unknown。发布材料只在高层支持 rlvr 和 preference_learning 用途标签，不支持开放数据、开放权重、过程监督或 RL 完全可复现等主张。

若要复用该思路，需要独立取得并确认许可的问题，明确参考答案与验证器语义，固定 rollout/评价器检查点版本，公开回放与重置规格、不可变阶段清单、奖励校准和污染检查。在这些产物出现前，本 Card 适合做跨报告披露比较与审计问题设计，不适合重建 Hunyuan-T1 配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the official release as a disclosure document: 96.7% is an RL compute share, not a sample, token, or rollout count.
  • Keep the two feedback stages separate: unspecified ground-truth feedback for reasoning RL, then T1-preview self-reward plus a reward model for preference alignment.
  • Treat curriculum, replay, and policy reset as named scaffolds; difficulty buckets, context schedule, replay policy, reset cadence, and RL objective are unknown.
  • Use the official GitHub repository and Hugging Face Space to verify the release/demo boundary, not as evidence of open weights, data, or training code.
  • Consult the later Hunyuan-TurboS report for related-family context only; do not transfer its 16T pre-training, 3M SFT, GRPO, or verifier details to Hunyuan-T1 without an explicit binding.

• 把官方发布页当作披露文档阅读：96.7% 是 RL 算力占比，不是样本数、token 数或 rollout 数。
  • 分开记录两类反馈：推理 RL 使用未明确的 ground-truth feedback，偏好对齐再使用 T1-preview self-reward 加 reward model。
  • 把课程、回放和策略重置视为已点名的 scaffold；难度桶、上下文日程、回放策略、重置周期和 RL 目标均是 unknown。
  • 用官方 GitHub 仓库和 Hugging Face Space核实发布/演示边界，不要把它们当作开放权重、数据或训练代码的证据。
  • 后续 Hunyuan-TurboS 报告仅用于相关家族背景；没有明确绑定时，不要把其中的 16T 预训练、3M SFT、GRPO 或验证器细节移植到 Hunyuan-T1。

items: The 96.7% figure is a compute-allocation claim, not a disclosed token count, sample count, or replayable training recipe.
Ground-truth real feedback does not identify whether tasks use exact match, symbolic equivalence, unit tests, theorem checking, human labels, or another verifier.
The unified self-reward plus reward-model scheme is not auditable without evaluator and reward-model versions, prompts, weights, calibration, and score logs.
The claimed more-than-50% stability improvement has no published metric definition, baseline, variance, or underlying training curves.
The official project repository and Hugging Face Space expose release text and an API demo, not training code, weights, datasets, a substantive model card, or verifier artifacts.
Benchmark results measure reported model behavior and do not establish provenance, legality, correctness, representativeness, or decontamination of the hidden training records.
